source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

title.en: US stocks rose, and Nvidia fell after the close
title.zh: 美股上涨，英伟达收盘后下跌

fact.en: The S&P 500 rose 1.31% to 7619.38 and the Nasdaq rose 1.60% to 25466.19, 华尔街见闻 reported. Nvidia fell more than 8% after the cash close as the board prepared to remove Jensen Huang, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：标普500上涨1.31%至7619.38，纳斯达克上涨1.60%至25466.19。英伟达在现金交易收盘后下跌超过8%，董事会准备罢免黄仁勋。

mechanism.en: The cash session rose, and Nvidia's drop came after the close with the board story. 财经早茶 (12 November): the board is preparing to remove Jensen Huang, and the shares fell hard after the close. US equities moved twice, up in the session and down in Nvidia after hours.
mechanism.zh: 现金交易时段是上涨的，英伟达的下跌发生在收盘之后，和董事会的消息在一起。财经早茶（11月12日）：董事会准备罢免黄仁勋，股价在收盘后大幅下跌。美股动了两次，时段内上涨，英伟达在盘后下跌。

title.en: The dollar hit its highest level since April 2025 while cash bonds were shut
title.zh: 美债现券休市，美元升至2025年4月以来最高

fact.en: The dollar index rose 0.66% to 102.908, the highest since April 2025, and cash Treasuries were shut for Veterans Day, 华尔街见闻 reported. Ten-year futures yields rose 2 to 4 basis points and may approach Tuesday's 5.01% intraday high, while the Market snapshot shows the Treasury official daily yield. A December increase is priced at 100%, with 86.8% on 25 basis points and 13.2% on 50 basis points, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：美元指数上涨0.66%至102.908，为2025年4月以来最高，美债现券因退伍军人节休市。10年期期货对应收益率上行2至4个基点，或重新逼近周二5.01%的盘中高点，行情快照展示的是财政部官方日度收益率。12月加息概率为100%，其中25个基点为86.8%，50个基点为13.2%。

mechanism.en: With cash bonds shut, the hike case showed up in the dollar and in futures. Goldman Sachs (12 November): a March increase is now in the path, after a path that had only December. The dollar and Treasury futures are paying for more than one increase.
mechanism.zh: 现券休市，加息的定价出现在美元和期货上。高盛（11月12日）：路径里现在包括3月加息，此前只看12月一次。美元和美债期货在为不止一次加息付钱。

title.en: Crude futures rose, and Saudi October output jumped
title.zh: 原油期货上涨，沙特10月产量跳升

fact.en: December WTI rose 0.57% to 86.53 dollars and January Brent rose 1.39% to 92.76 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported. Saudi Arabia's October crude output rose 26% to 1056 ten-thousand barrels a day, and Brent is down about 21% this month, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月WTI上涨0.57%至86.53美元，1月布伦特上涨1.39%至92.76美元。沙特10月原油产量增长26%，至每日1056万桶，布伦特本月约下跌21%。

mechanism.en: Crude futures rose on the day even though Saudi supply is much higher and Brent is still down about 21% this month. 财经早茶 (12 November): traders are weighing mixed signals on whether the Iran war is ending. The move is in December WTI and January Brent.
mechanism.zh: 原油期货当天上涨，尽管沙特供给高了很多，布伦特本月仍约下跌21%。财经早茶（11月12日）：交易员在权衡伊朗战争是否走向结束的不同信号。变动在12月WTI和1月布伦特。

title.en: COMEX gold futures fell under 4000 dollars
title.zh: COMEX黄金期货跌到4000美元下方

fact.en: COMEX gold futures fell 0.71% to 3992.00 dollars an ounce and moved back under 4000, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot shows Yahoo's intraday gold futures quote, a different quote from this futures close.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX黄金期货下跌0.71%至每盎司3992.00美元，重新回到4000下方。行情快照展示的是Yahoo黄金期货盘中价，和这一期货收盘不是同一报价。

mechanism.en: COMEX gold futures fell under 4000 as rate-increase bets rose. 财经早茶 (12 November): gold fell while hotter inflation lifted expectations for Federal Reserve rate increases. The move is in COMEX gold futures.
mechanism.zh: 加息押注上升，COMEX黄金期货跌到4000下方。财经早茶（11月12日）：通胀偏热推升美联储加息预期，黄金下跌。变动在COMEX黄金期货。

title.en: Shanghai rose, and the ChiNext index rose much more
title.zh: 上证上涨，创业板指涨得更多

fact.en: Shanghai rose 0.46% to 3680.64 and the ChiNext index rose 3.11% to 2572.07, with turnover of 1.69 trillion yuan, 1719 hundred million yuan above the prior session, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证上涨0.46%至3680.64，创业板指上涨3.11%至2572.07，成交1.69万亿元，较前一交易日放量1719亿元。

mechanism.en: The ChiNext index rose much more than Shanghai, and turnover was higher than the prior session. PBOC (11 November): policy stays moderately loose, and the swap facility for large non-bank bond redemptions is there to keep stocks, bonds, and the currency market stable. A-shares rose with that stance in place.
mechanism.zh: 创业板指的涨幅远大于上证，成交也高于前一交易日。中国人民银行（11月11日）：政策保持适度宽松，债市非银大额赎回互换便利用来维护股票、债券和外汇市场稳定。A股是在这一表态下上涨的。

fact.en: Three-month LME copper rose 138 dollars to 13817 dollars a tonne, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：伦敦三个月期铜上涨138美元，至每吨13817美元。

mechanism.en: Three-month copper rose 138 dollars to 13817 dollars a tonne on a day when US stocks rose. The change showed up in the copper price.
mechanism.zh: 美股上涨的这一天，三个月期铜上涨138美元，至每吨13817美元。变化落在铜价上。

title.en: London aluminum's nearby premium hit a 30-year high
title.zh: 伦敦铝近月溢价创30年高位

fact.en: LME aluminum rose 58 dollars to 3068 dollars a tonne, and the spot premium over three-month futures hit 147 dollars, the highest in more than 30 years, 华尔街见闻 reported. The tom/next spread touched 31.73 dollars and then narrowed to 1 dollar.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：伦铝上涨58美元至每吨3068美元，现货对三个月期货的溢价一度达到147美元，为30多年最高。Tom/next价差一度触及31.73美元，随后收窄至1美元。

mechanism.en: The premium says nearby aluminum is scarce relative to metal for later delivery. 财经早茶 (12 November): buyers face the tightest supply in decades because deliverable stocks dropped, and aluminum rose overnight. Aluminum prices are paying for that scarcity.
mechanism.zh: 溢价说明近月的铝比更远的交割更紧。财经早茶（11月12日）：可交割库存下降，买家面临数十年来最紧的供给，隔夜铝价上涨。铝价在为这种紧缺付钱。

title.en: China's October exports rose 35.2% from a year earlier, and the pace eased
title.zh: 中国10月出口同比增长35.2%，增速已经放缓

fact.en: October exports rose 35.2% from a year earlier, 1.1 percentage points slower than September, and imports rose 41.6%, 财新 reported.
fact.zh: 财新：10月出口同比增长35.2%，较9月放缓1.1个百分点，进口同比增长41.6%。

mechanism.en: The total pace is still very fast, and it is already slower than September. CICC (10 November): exports matched the survey, imports were above it, and the rise in export prices may be past its peak, so the overall pace could slow as the base gets higher. Technology goods on the chart grew faster than the total, and that gap did not come with a change in the 35.2% pace.
mechanism.zh: 整体增速仍然很快，而且已经慢于9月。中金（11月10日）：出口与调查一致，进口高于调查，出口价格的升幅或已过高点，所以随着基数抬高，整体增速可能放缓。图上科技产品快于整体，这个差距并没有改动35.2%的整体增速。

title.en: Anthropic's whole deal is up to 90.4 billion dollars, and demand ran ahead of the shares
title.zh: Anthropic整笔交易最高904亿美元，认购超过可供股份

fact.en: Anthropic's amended S-1 sets a price range of 70 to 78 dollars a share. At the 74 dollar midpoint, net proceeds to the company are about 84.6 billion dollars, before the underwriters' option. BlockBeats reported a total deal size of up to 90.4 billion dollars, including shares sold by existing holders, and 华尔街见闻 reported demand several times the shares on offer, with a fully diluted value target of 1.4 trillion dollars.
fact.zh: Anthropic修订版S-1：发行价区间为每股70至78美元。按74美元的区间中点，公司净募资约846亿美元，未计承销商超额配售。律动：交易总规模最高约904亿美元，含老股出售。华尔街见闻：认购达到可供股份的数倍，完全稀释价值目标为1.4万亿美元。

mechanism.en: The 90.4 billion dollar figure is the whole deal at the top of the range, and the 84.6 billion dollars is what the company keeps at the 74 dollar midpoint by its own filing. CICC (6 November): confidence in the spending story needs a real break in the business, of the kind associated with Anthropic, before it returns. US equities meet that through the new listing.
mechanism.zh: 904亿美元是按区间上限计算的整笔交易，846亿美元是公司按74美元中点、用自己的招股书估算的净募资。中金（11月6日）：支出这条线的信心要回来，需要业务上出现真正的突破，而这类突破和市场对Anthropic的期待是绑在一起的。影响落在美股的新上市上。

title.en: UK and European short-dated bonds lagged after oil rose
title.zh: 油价回升后，英国和欧洲短期债券跑输

fact.en: UK and European short-dated government bonds lagged after crude prices rose, and traders raised bets on Bank of England and ECB rate increases, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：油价回升后，英国及欧洲短期国债跑输，交易员上调了英国央行和欧洲央行的加息押注。

mechanism.en: Short-dated UK and European bonds fell behind after oil rose, which is the rate-bet channel. 财经早茶 (12 November): traders marked up Bank of England and ECB rate increases once crude turned higher. Those bond prices are the market that moved.
mechanism.zh: 油价上涨之后，英国和欧洲的短期债券落后了，这是加息押注的渠道。财经早茶（11月12日）：原油转涨后，交易员上调了英国央行和欧洲央行的加息。变动落在这些债券的价格上。

title.en: Bitcoin funds and stablecoins both lost cash
title.zh: 比特币基金和稳定币都在流失资金

fact.en: Over 20 sessions US spot bitcoin ETFs had 1.6 billion dollars of net outflows, and over 30 days total stablecoin supply fell by 14.2 billion dollars, the fastest drop since June 2022, Glassnode reported.
fact.zh: Glassnode：美国现货比特币ETF在20个交易日净流出16亿美元，稳定币总供给在30天里减少142亿美元，为2022年6月以来最快。

mechanism.en: The outflow is a net flow, and it does not say how many bitcoin the funds still hold. Glassnode (11 November): stablecoin holders are redeeming for dollars and taking that cash out, and the ETFs have been net sellers. The effect is on US spot bitcoin funds and on stablecoin cash.
mechanism.zh: 这是净流量，不是这些基金还持有多少比特币。Glassnode（11月11日）：稳定币持有人在赎回美元并把现金带出市场，ETF则在净卖出。影响落在美国现货比特币基金和稳定币现金上。

globalRegime.en: US stocks rose and crude prices rose. COMEX gold futures fell under 4000 dollars, and the dollar index rose to its highest level since April 2025 while cash Treasuries were shut. China's October exports rose 35.2% from a year earlier, technology goods on the chart rose faster than that total, and the ChiNext index rose more than Shanghai.
globalRegime.zh: 美股上涨，原油价格上涨。COMEX黄金期货跌到4000美元下方，美债现券休市，美元指数升至2025年4月以来最高。中国10月出口同比增长35.2%，图上科技产品快于这一整体增速，创业板指的涨幅大于上证。

text.en: The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang had an affair with an Nvidia executive who reports to him. The Wall Street Journal reported that the board is preparing to remove him and could meet as early as Wednesday. The shares fell more than 8% after the close, 财经早茶 reported, and 华尔街见闻 carried the same after-hours drop.
text.zh: 财经早茶：《纽约时报》报道黄仁勋与一名向其汇报的英伟达高管有过婚外情。《华尔街日报》报道董事会准备罢免他，最早周三开会。收盘后股价下跌超过8%。华尔街见闻也报道了同样的盘后跌幅。

text.en: The chair of the US House China committee said Nvidia's credibility on AI-chip export controls is damaged, and Congress is ready to subpoena Jensen Huang if he will not attend a closed briefing, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国众议院中国特设委员会主席表示，英伟达在人工智能芯片出口管制上信誉受损，若黄仁勋不同意出席闭门说明会，国会准备发出传票。

text.en: Baird cut Nvidia to neutral and cut its price target. Morgan Stanley removed the shares from its preferred list, 财经早茶 reported. 华尔街见闻 also reported the Morgan Stanley change, and said the bank kept a positive rating.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国投行Baird将英伟达评级下调至中性，并下调目标价。摩根士丹利将该股移出首选名单。华尔街见闻也报道了摩根士丹利的调整，并称该行维持正面评级。

text.en: CoreWeave is seeking at least 4 billion dollars of investment-grade loans. The shares jumped in the cash session and then fell after hours with Nvidia, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：CoreWeave寻求通过投资级贷款融资至少40亿美元。该股在现金交易时段大涨，盘后随英伟达下跌。

text.en: Anthropic's IPO is said to be several times oversubscribed, and the large-cap Nasdaq index rebounded during the session as buyers returned to the AI trade, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Anthropic首次公开募股据悉已获数倍认购。AI交易吸引买盘，纳指在交易时段反弹。

text.en: Jack Selby of Copper Sky warned that Anthropic's IPO could mark a top for the AI trade, and that a weak listing could bring heavy selling when the lockup ends, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Copper Sky的Jack Selby警告，不排除Anthropic的IPO成为AI行情见顶的信号，若上市后表现不及预期，禁售期届满可能遭遇猛烈抛售。

text.en: UBS Asset Management warned that the AI investment boom has created a debt web whose risks are underappreciated, and Sixth Street's chief executive is also cautious, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：瑞银资管警告，AI投资热潮催生的债务网络被市场严重低估。Sixth Street的首席执行官也对这股热潮保持谨慎。

text.en: Marsh & McLennan is lobbying US regulators to let banks hold less capital against loans covered by credit-risk insurance, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Marsh & McLennan游说美国监管机构，允许银行对有信用风险保险覆盖的贷款计提较少资本。

text.en: Saudi Arabia's October crude output rose 26% to 1056 ten-thousand barrels a day, Iraq's output reached a wartime high near 490 ten-thousand barrels a day, and Brent is down about 21% this month, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：沙特10月原油日产量增长26%至1056万桶，伊拉克产量升至约每日490万桶的战时高位，布伦特本月约下跌21%。

text.en: Former UK prime minister Cameron told prime minister Burnham not to seek to rejoin the European Union, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：英国前首相卡梅伦告诫现首相伯纳姆不要寻求重新加入欧盟。

text.en: London aluminum buyers face the tightest supply in decades. The spot premium over three-month futures hit 147 dollars, and the tom/next spread touched 31.73 dollars before narrowing to 1 dollar, 华尔街见闻 reported. Aluminum rose overnight, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：伦敦铝买家面临数十年来最紧的供给。现货对三个月期货溢价一度达到147美元，Tom/next价差一度触及31.73美元，随后收窄至1美元。财经早茶：隔夜伦敦期铝上涨。

text.en: The second day of US-led Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi ended with the Russian delegation chief saying the two sides are closer to peace, and Zelensky called the political changes a window, 财经早茶 reported. 华尔街见闻 reported that the session lasted under two hours and that the sides agreed in principle to a prisoner swap of more than 1000 people each.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国主导的俄乌谈判在阿布扎比结束第二天，俄方代表团团长称双方更接近和平，泽连斯基称政治变化打开了窗口。华尔街见闻：会谈不到两小时，双方原则同意各自交换超过1000人。

text.en: Goldman Sachs, Nomura, and Deutsche Bank each added another rate increase to the path they expect from the Federal Reserve, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：高盛、野村和德银都在各自预计的美联储路径里增加了一次加息。

text.en: Nvidia fell as much as 9% after hours as the board prepared to remove Jensen Huang, 律动 reported.
text.zh: 律动：英伟达董事会准备罢免黄仁勋，盘后股价跌幅最多达到9%。

text.en: If the board keeps Jensen Huang and Nvidia's shares retrace the after-hours drop, Wednesday's split between the indexes and Nvidia could close.
text.zh: 若董事会留任黄仁勋，且英伟达股价补回盘后跌幅，周三指数与英伟达之间的分化可能收拢。

text.en: If December WTI falls back through 86.53 dollars and January Brent through 92.76 dollars, Wednesday's crude rebound could fade.
text.zh: 若12月WTI跌回86.53美元、1月布伦特跌回92.76美元，周三的原油反弹可能消退。

text.en: If COMEX gold futures settle back above 4000 dollars, the latest drop could be retraced.
text.zh: 若COMEX黄金期货结算价回到4000美元上方，最近这次下跌可能被补回。

globalTensions.en: US stocks rose while COMEX gold futures fell and the dollar rose. Crude futures rose even as Saudi October output jumped and Brent is still down about 21% this month. Nvidia fell after the close while the indexes had finished higher. A-shares rose and the Hang Seng fell.
globalTensions.zh: 美股上涨，COMEX黄金期货下跌，美元上涨。原油期货上涨，但沙特10月产量跳升，布伦特本月仍约下跌21%。指数收高之后，英伟达在收盘后下跌。A股上涨，恒生指数下跌。

chinaStance.en: The PBOC's third-quarter report keeps moderately loose policy, watches the risk of an exchange-rate overshoot, and says the swap facility for large non-bank bond redemptions is there to keep markets stable. Offshore yuan was a bit stronger on the session. October exports are still growing very fast, and the pace has already eased.
chinaStance.zh: 央行三季度报告坚持适度宽松，关注汇率超调风险，并称债市非银大额赎回互换便利用来维护市场稳定。离岸人民币这一交易日略强。10月出口增速仍然很快，而且已经放缓。

text.en: The PBOC's third-quarter report keeps moderately loose policy, warns on an exchange-rate overshoot, and says it will watch how tax treatment affects government bond yields, 财经早茶 reported. First-three-quarter GDP rose 4.6%, technology relending rose by 2000 hundred million yuan with the support ratio moving from 60% to 100%, rural and small-firm relending rose by 5000 hundred million yuan, and average DR001 was 1.34%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：央行三季度货币政策执行报告坚持适度宽松，防范汇率超调，并关注税收对国债收益率的影响。华尔街见闻：前三季度GDP同比增长4.6%，科技创新再贷款增加2000亿元、支持比例由60%上调至100%，支农支小再贷款增加5000亿元，DR001均值1.34%。

text.en: Offshore-trust filings have declared more than 1600 hundred million yuan of back tax, more than 1200 hundred million yuan was paid in October, and national personal-income-tax revenue jumped nearly 90% that month, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：离岸信托累计申报补税超过1600亿元，10月入库超过1200亿元，当月全国个人所得税收入增长近90%。

text.en: The annual window for China's dollar sovereign bond is open. The Ministry of Finance will issue up to 2 billion dollars in Hong Kong next week, the second offshore sovereign sale this month, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国一年一度的美元主权债窗口开启，财政部下周将在香港发行不超过20亿美元，这也是本月第二次境外主权债发行。

text.en: Yangtze Memory Technologies is aiming for a STAR Market listing in Shanghai in the first quarter of 2027, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：长江存储力争2027年第一季度在上海科创板上市。

text.en: ByteDance plans to launch an AI agent in the coming weeks, and co-founder Zhang Yiming said the company could match leading labs between 2029 and 2030, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：字节跳动计划未来数周推出人工智能智能体，联合创始人张一鸣称公司最快可在2029年至2030年与顶尖实验室抗衡。

text.en: Baidu released a preview model aimed at coding and at 3D design tools, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：百度发布预览模型，面向编码场景，并加强三维设计工具上的能力。

text.en: VW brand's October new-energy deliveries in China hit a record and rose sharply from a year earlier, and the company wants a top-ten place among China new-energy brands next year, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：大众品牌10月在中国的新能源车交付创历史纪录，同比大幅增长，公司力争明年进入中国新能源品牌销量前十。

text.en: COFCO International ordered at least two cargoes of French wheat and one cargo of Argentine wheat last week, which would be China's largest French wheat purchase since 2024, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中粮国际上周订购了至少两船法国小麦和一船阿根廷小麦，这将是中国自2024年以来从法国进口的最大规模。

text.en: The German military banned Chinese-made training drones and limited some vehicles on bases after an assessment found a risk that data could be sent to Chinese intelligence, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：德国军方在评估发现数据有被传送至中国情报机构的风险后，禁止使用中国制造的训练用无人机，并限制部分车辆进入军事基地。

text.en: The PBOC's report says loan pricing is moving off a single LPR reference, and that government-bond interest is tax-free, so yields have to be compared on an after-tax basis, 财新 reported.
text.zh: 财新：央行报告称贷款定价正从单一参考LPR转向更多基准，国债利息免所得税，比较收益率时要还原税收因素。

text.en: Foreign minister Wang Yi spoke with US secretary of state Rubio about the relationship and contacts between the two presidents, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：王毅同美国国务卿鲁比奥通电话，双方就中美关系和两国元首互动交换了意见。

text.en: Offshore yuan was at 6.6730, and the yuan was 0.04% stronger on the session, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot USD/CNY row is a different quote.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：离岸人民币报6.6730，人民币升值0.04%。行情快照的美元兑人民币一行是另一报价。

text.en: If technology-goods export growth slows toward the 35.2% total, the gap on the chart could narrow, which is the direction CICC described on 10 November.
text.zh: 若科技产品出口增速向35.2%的整体增速靠拢，图上的差距可能收窄，这是中金11月10日描述的方向。

text.en: If the ChiNext index gives back the close at 2572.07, the day's equity rise could look thinner.
text.zh: 若创业板指把2572.07的收盘涨幅吐回去，当天的股市上涨可能显得更弱。

chinaDivergences.en: The ChiNext index rose 3.11% while Shanghai rose 0.46%, and the Hang Seng fell 0.98%. US stocks rose while the Hang Seng fell. Crude futures rose while COMEX gold futures fell. Offshore yuan was a bit stronger, at 6.6730.
chinaDivergences.zh: 创业板指上涨3.11%，上证上涨0.46%，恒生指数下跌0.98%。美股上涨，恒生指数下跌。原油期货上涨，COMEX黄金期货下跌。离岸人民币略强，报6.6730。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 12 November, through next Friday, 20 November. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy meeting falls in these dates. After the November switch to standard time, a policy decision at 14:00 US Eastern would be 03:00 Beijing the next day.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月12日到下周五11月20日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息会议。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。

event.zh: 英国第三季度GDP初值，以及工业生产和贸易差额

event.zh: 美国初请失业金人数，预期19.5万人，前值18.9万人
克利夫兰联储行长哈马克讲话

event.en: US October existing-home sales, forecast 3.85 million after 3.99 million
event.zh: 美国10月成屋销售，预期385万户，前值399万户
芝加哥联储行长古尔斯比讲话

event.en: US weekly crude inventories, delayed one day for Veterans Day
event.zh: 美国周度原油库存，因退伍军人节推迟一天

event.en: San Francisco Fed president Daly speaks
event.zh: 旧金山联储行长戴利讲话

event.zh: 堪萨斯城联储行长施密德讲话
欧洲央行行长拉加德讲话

event.zh: 国内成品油调价窗口，北京时间11月12日24:00

event.zh: 韩国金融委员会召开资本市场座谈会

event.zh: 中国1至10月信贷与货币供应，11月12日至15日之间

sources.en: The mail copy is the 12 November 财经早茶. Wednesday equity, oil, gold, dollar, and Asia closes are 华尔街见闻. October trade is 财新. 律动 covers the Nvidia after-hours move and Anthropic's total deal size. The SEC filing gives net proceeds. Glassnode covers bitcoin-fund flows and stablecoin supply. CICC's 6 November note sits on US equities, and the 10 November note sits on exports. The chart figures are approximate readings from the chart.
sources.zh: 邮件底稿是11月12日财经早茶。周三的股票、原油、黄金、美元和亚洲收盘来自华尔街见闻。10月贸易来自财新。律动覆盖英伟达盘后走势和Anthropic的交易总规模。SEC招股书给出净募资。Glassnode覆盖比特币基金流向和稳定币供给。中金11月6日的笔记写在美股上，11月10日的笔记写在出口上。图上的数字是从图上读出的约数。

caveats: Event Calendar mainland China only on China rows. Equity, FX, gold, and Brent rows in Market snapshot are the inject snapshot. The chart heights are approximate readings of the image. Desk lines name the desk.

note.en: Equities, FX, gold futures, and Brent futures use the latest Yahoo daily bar; a session still open at the snapshot is intraday, not a close (Brent row is Yahoo BZ=F — not the same print as the CNBC settle); US Treasuries use the official daily yield curve (bp vs prior print); BTC is CoinGecko 24h change; funding compares adjacent OKX prints. Snapshot captured at generate time — not live on the page.
note.zh: 股票、外汇、黄金期货和布伦特期货采用 Yahoo 最近日线柱；快照时尚未收盘的时段是盘中，不是收盘（布伦特一行是 Yahoo BZ=F，与 CNBC 结算价不是同一报价）；美国国债采用官方日度收益率曲线（相对前值的基点）；比特币为 CoinGecko 的 24 小时变动；资金费率比较相邻的 OKX 报价。快照取自生成时点，不是本页实时行情。

printNote.en: The text cites Tuesday's 5.01% intraday high in 10-year futures (华尔街见闻). This row is the Treasury official daily yield.
printNote.zh: 正文引用的是周二10年期期货盘中高点5.01%（华尔街见闻）。这一行是美国财政部官方日度收益率。

printNote.en: The text cites offshore yuan at 6.6730, with the yuan 0.04% stronger on the session (华尔街见闻).
printNote.zh: 正文引用的是离岸人民币6.6730，人民币这一交易日升值0.04%（华尔街见闻）。

printNote.en: The text cites COMEX gold futures at 3992.00 dollars, down 0.71% (华尔街见闻).
printNote.zh: 正文引用的是COMEX黄金期货3992.00美元，下跌0.71%（华尔街见闻）。

printNote.en: The text cites January Brent at 92.76 dollars, up 1.39% (华尔街见闻).
printNote.zh: 正文引用的是1月布伦特92.76美元，上涨1.39%（华尔街见闻）。
